summary.result: Runoff pollution loadings due to the upland field in order to identify the characteristics of various crops, farming methods and a variety of targets taking into account regional characteristics by conducting continuous monitoring runoff load estimate will be required.
summary.background: Irrigation, runoff and water quality data in the upland were analyzed periodically from May to November in 2011.
